base="https://urbo-maven.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/releases"; for p in \
  "io/swcode/urbo/build/logic/root-project/io.swcode.urbo.build.logic.root-project.gradle.plugin/1.0.56/io.swcode.urbo.build.logic.root-project.gradle.plugin-1.0.56.pom" \
  "io/swcode/urbo/build/logic/root-project/1.0.56/root-project-1.0.56.pom" \
  "io/swcode/urbo/build/logic/root-project/maven-metadata.xml" \
  "releases/io/swcode/urbo/build/logic/root-project/1.0.56/root-project-1.0.56.pom" ; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/o -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 15 "$base/$p"); echo "$code  $p"; done
